approach: Matching decompilation: the C source rebuilds the USA ROM byte for byte (make check)
notes: Forked from Mr-Wiseguy/banjo-tooie at 13.0 % matched code (upstream state of 2025-11-29); the remaining 87 % were matched in this fork. All code is matched (100 %), and .data, .rodata and .bss are defined in C except where they belong to handwritten asm. A hybrid project: part of the matching was done by hand, much of it was produced with different AI models as part of a research project on AI-assisted decompilation (more in the README). Every function is verified byte-identical against the ROM. Cleanup and documentation are under way.
